meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 对代码做深度安全审计:检查 OWASP Top 10、认证与授权、硬编码密钥、依赖漏洞,有 Solidity 还会查合约,最后把结论与修复顺序写成报告存到 docs/reviews/。
howto.when: 在发布前、改动认证/授权/数据处理的代码后,或新增依赖与外部集成时触发;未指定范围时审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.note: 没写范围时就审计整个 src/ 目录。
只审计指定目录,报告写入 docs/reviews/。

say.text: 审计 src/payments/,看看有没有硬编码密钥
say.note: 密钥扫描结果会写进报告。

howto.what_en: Runs a deep security audit: OWASP Top 10, auth, hardcoded secrets, dependency CVEs, and Solidity contracts. Writes findings and fix order to docs/reviews/.
howto.when_en: Use before a release, after code changes touching authentication, authorization, or data handling, or when adding dependencies. With no scope, the whole src/ directory is audited.

say_en.note: Audits the whole src/ directory when no scope is given.

say_en.text: Audit src/payments/ and flag any hardcoded secrets
say_en.note: Secrets scan results appear in the report.
